Name: Fishing Tackle Tooltips
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
Rewrites the "You've used your last piece of bait" and "Your fishing tackle has worn out" popups to remind you what kind of bait/tackle you ran out of. Additionally, you can use the "tackle_tooltip" console command while holding a fishing rod to see what bait/tackle you ran out of most recently on that rod in case you forget again!

Source available on [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url].

Downloads.Description: Update to be compatible with SDV 1.6.15
